title: Board Termination Dividend Schedule: Full Surrender of Whole Life Insurance After Long Continuous Coverage
content:
**Product:** Whole Life Insurance (Ashgrove), including policies issued by conversion of an Ashgrove Term Life Insurance policy.

A termination dividend is paid with a full surrender for long continuous coverage on the insured, counted in whole months **to the surrender effective date** from the issue date of the Ashgrove Term Life Insurance policy converted into this policy, or from this policy's own issue date when it was not issued by conversion.

| Whole months of continuous coverage | Never reinstated | Termination dividend |
|---|---|---|
| 360 or more | Yes | 3% (0.03) of the guaranteed cash value |
| 240 or more, below 360 | Yes | 1.5% (0.015) of the guaranteed cash value |
| Below 240 | Yes | None |
| Any | No | None |

The termination dividend is figured on the guaranteed cash value from the most recent anniversary statement; the amount paid is rounded half up to the cent and counts toward the gross cash value of the surrender.

**Records read.** The whole life policy record (issue date, converted term policy reference, reinstatement date, guaranteed cash value) and, for a converted policy, the issue date on the Term Life Insurance policy record. A whole month is counted each time the same day of the month as the start date is reached.

**Cases (hypothetical, guaranteed cash value 40000.00, surrender effective July 10, 2025).**

- Converted from a Term Life Insurance policy issued July 10, 1995, never reinstated: 360 months, 1200.00.
- Converted from a Term Life Insurance policy issued July 11, 1995: 359 months, 600.00.
- Issued on application August 1, 2003, never reinstated: 263 months, 600.00.
- Issued on application in 1990 and reinstated in 2012: none.
